summary.ru: Северная Лян — одно из 16 варварских государств, на которые распался в IV веке Северный Китай. Существовало в 397—439 годах.
summary.en: The Northern Liang was a dynastic state of China and one of the Sixteen Kingdoms in Chinese history. It was ruled by the Juqu family of Lushuihu ethnicity, though they are sometimes categorized as Xiongnu in some historiographies. Although Duan Ye of Han ethnicity was initially enthroned as the Northern Liang ruler with support from the Juqu clan, Duan was subsequently overthrown in 401 and Juqu Mengxun was proclaimed monarch.
